title: Checkers with Runway 13
subtitle: A city, an airport, and the limits of what the archive lets us recover
idea: Create the signature public illustration without pretending to a complete historical city.
limit: The photographic panorama and airport map are separate views, not a seamless calibrated terrain/city model. The geographic inset supplies context; missing areas do not mean empty Hong Kong.
caption: The reconstructed city appears as an incomplete relief beside the historical airport geography. Together they show why this place invites investigation, while leaving the unknown architecture visibly unresolved.
